name: Instinctual Alpha (Faunal)
body:
As your animal features grow ever more pronounced, so too does your animal dominance.

Prerequisite(s): Bond of Fauna

Benefit(s): You gain a bonus to Handle Animal and, if you have druid class levels, wild empathy checks equal to the total number of Faunal feats you have.

Call of the Wild, Book 1 – The Druid. © 2017 d20pfsrd.com Publishing; Author: Kalen Tessmann
